tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thob pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba las 'khon ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyis rjes su bzung ba'i tshul gyi sarga bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ shrī mañdzu gho ṣa nā tha bhu mi paṇ+ḍu lo ka shwa ra a nan+da pu n+ya ni ra bho ga ye na mo/ bod skad du/ dpal mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa skya pa 'jig rten dbang phyug kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun dga'i gzugs sku 'gro ba'i bsod nams su/ /lhun gyis grub pa bkra shis grags pa'i gter/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mdzad 'phrin can/ /dpal 'byor bzang po sa skya pa de bsngags/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du/ dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin mnos pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar/ ༈ tshe dpag med dze tā ri lha dgu'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri/ byang chub bzang po/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ e pa 'khon ston/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ grags pa dpal/ sru lung pa kun dga' smon lam/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ sa bzang ma ti/ theg chen pa/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dpal chos pa/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/

des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan yan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ de nas bla ma dam pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ dpal tshul ba/ chos rje shar pa/ ngor chen kun bzang / sems dpa' chen po/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ rje sangs rin pa/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje man 'dra'o/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang yan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ ngor chen kun bzang / mkhas grub dpal rdor ba/ mi nyag grags rdor ba/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje man gong bzhin no/ ༈ /yang 'khon sa skya pa'i yab chos dpal yang dag he ru ka mar me dgu par grags pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ ro langs bde ba'i dngos grub/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra/ bal po shī la mañdzu/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ gnyal dzñā na ku ma ra/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ gtsug tor shes rab/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ kha 'ub pa 'od ldan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros dpung rgyan mdzes pa'i tog dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams dar/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ mtshungs med nam mkha' blo gros/ chag lo tsā ba rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/

sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na nye brgyud ni/ dpal he ru ka slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen man gong bzhin no/ /yang na sa chen kun dga' snying po nas/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa shes rab blo gros/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan man gong dang 'dra'o/ /de'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba dang / dkyil chog blo dman dga' ba skyed byed dang / rdul tshon la brten nas sgrub mchod byed tshul rnams sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa rnams thos/ yang phur pa'i dkyil chog rdo rje las rim slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa dzñā na ku ma ra'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs chung ngu sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma rje btsun gyis mdzad par grags pa/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa bklags pas don grub/ 'bring po don grub snying po/ bsdus pa yang snying lhan skyes dkyil chog rtogs par sla ba/ de'i lhan thabs rin po che'i do shal dang / sgrub thabs chung ngu sa los mdzad pa/ yang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga blo gros kha 'byed dang / dbang gi mtshams sbyar blo gsal dga' bskyed sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa thos so/ ༈ /yang rdo rje 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ grub chen nā ro pa/ a s+d+yu la badz+ra/ bha ro phyag rdum/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/

gan pa rin rgyal/ bla chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang / chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje bud+dha singha/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na 'dren mchog bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/ rje bud+dha/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i lung thos so/ ༈ /lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid thob pa las/ thog mar tog rtse pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rta mchog mda' can/ bī ṇa ba/ pi wang 'dzin/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti/ phun tshogs zhabs/ grub chen sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ gun+dha ri pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ chos kyi pa/ bzang po'i zhabs/ tog rtse pa/ 'jor 'dzin/ bhu ṣa ṇa/ dha ma pa/ kah+na/ grub thob/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi/ se ston/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa chen/ bsod rtse/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal tshul/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen kun bzang / mus chen dkon rgyal/ zha lu pa chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na ngor chen kun bzang / mkhas mchog dkon blo/ mkhas btsun dpal ldan rgyal po/ rje nam mkha'i mtshan can/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ ༈ /bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇa chen/ 'od shāka la ru ba/ ye shes mgon po/

bag ston/ gzhon tshul/ tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man gong dang 'dra/ ༈ /phyag rgya chen po yi ge med kyi byin rlabs gdams ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ de ba a kar tsan+d+ra/ de gnyis ka la jo bo a mo gha badz+ra gyis gsan/ de la 'brog mis gsan/ bla ma se mkhar chung ba man gong dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /mchod rten drung thob kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ar+ya de wa/ dge slong nag po zhabs/ zla ba grags pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ma he'i dbu can/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man gong dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs can/ dza lan+dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa/ shrī dha ra/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o/ ༈ /yon po srong ba'i brgyud pa yang de dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /in+d+ra bo dhi'i lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ /dang po dpal ldan sde'i zhal snga na/ in+d+ra bo dhi che ba/ /de bzhin du drang srong gzugs/ yang tshangs pa 'i zhabs/ dang / /bram ze mo ni rdo rje grub/ rnal 'byor ma/ /de nas shrī badz+ra bo dhi bar pa rgyal/ /de'i slob dpon de'i phyi ma u pa ma'i zhabs dang / /gos bral gcer bu/ zhal snga de bzhin no/ /dpal ldan dzñā na chung ba bo dhi rgyal/ /de bzhin shrī yo bo dhi dang / /slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra dang / /ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i zhal snga de bzhin no/ /yan lag bar pa dpal ldan mo/ /bung ba'i mkha' 'gro ma pad+ma de bzhin no/ /dur khrod du na kī lar bzhugs/ /lha lcam legs smin de bzhin no/ /bdag kyang dang po grub pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje 'chang / dpal bde ba chen po/ in+d+ra bo dhi/ dpal tshangs pa'i zhabs/ bram ze mo/ grub pa'i rdo rje/

rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi bar pa/ slob dpon u pa ma'i zhabs/ slob dpon gos bral zhabs/ rgyal po dzñā na bo dhi/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka yan lag bar ma'i zhabs/ lha mo bung ba'i pad+ma/ lcam legs smin/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi chung ba/ de'i slob ma bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ de la kha che shes rab gsang bas gsan/ de la 'brog mi ste de man 'dra'o/ /nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / in+d+ra bo dhi che ba/ lcam legs smin/ shes rab gsang ba/ 'brog mi man chad gong bzhin no/ ༈ /pad+ma badz+ra'i lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bi la ba badz+ra/ grub thob chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ in+d+ra bo dhi/ lcam legs smin/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ rje ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o/ ༈ /ḍom+bhi pa'i lhan cig skyes grub kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ḍom+bhi ba/ a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man sngar dang 'dra'o/ /khrid yig rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung la lung rigs smra ba mgon po rin chen gyis zin bris mdzad pa'i steng nas gnang / lam skor brgyad kyi khrid yig sa skya pa gong mas mdzad pa rnams dang / bsam mi khyab kyi rgya gzhung / rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i mchan bu sa bcad dang bcas pa/ mar me'i rtse mo'i rgya gzhung / lhan cig skyes grub kyi rgya gzhung / bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs bya tshul 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos mdzad pa de'i lo rgyus/ lam skor dgu'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa rnams thos so/ ༈ /yang mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can dmar mo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rwa pa chos grags/ bla ma don yod rdo rje/

paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen/ lo tsā ba mañdzu shrī/ bsam grub rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun a nan+da dh+wa dza/ rdo rje 'chang nor bu phun tshogs/ mkhas grub lha dbang blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i lha mo sna tshogs yum gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shrī kā la tsakra/ mahā paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen/ lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/ chag lo gsum pa/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug drin chen byams pa rab brtan/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i lung yang thos/ ༈ /yang gnyos mgon trak+shad lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze mchog sred/ rnal 'byor pa ro zan de wa/ rnal 'byor ma bde ster ma/ bla ma ba liṃ ta a tsār+ya/ kha rag gi gnyos lo tsā ba/ sras rdo rje bla ma/ dpal 'byung / dpal seng / yab grags pa dpal/ sangs rgyas ras chen/ bla ma rin chen rgyal po/ bla ma byang dar/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen 'byung gnas/ mkhas btsun ye shes rin chen/ kun spangs chos kyi rin chen/ dbu ma pa dpal ldan rin chen/ byang sems bsod nams rin chen/ brag dkar ba sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje blo gsal rgya mtsho/ chos rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na mnyam med sangs rgyas ras chen/ rgyal sras stag tshangs pa/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas phyar chen/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen 'byung gnas/ drin chen mkhas btsun sangs rgyas/ kun mkhyen saṃ ga bha dra/

rgyud 'dzin sangs rgyas bzang po/ dbu ma pa man gong dang 'dra/ chos skyong chen po trak+shad dang / mgon po stag bzhon gyi gtor chog rjes gnang gi yi ge rje thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang bas mdzad pa'i lung yang thos/ ༈ /yang chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba/ kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i spyi don rta bdun gyi rgyal po sdom gsum nyams len gsal ba zhes bya ba dang / ṭik+ka rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs gsal gnyis kyi steng nas bshad lung zhib tu thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bro lung pa/ mkhas pa dkon mchog grags/ g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje gzhon nu seng ge mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gung ru shes rab bzang po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge chos rje kun dga' mchog ldan/ 'dren mchog nam mkha' dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyi rjes su/ rje dharma pa/ rje ma ho pa dh+ya ya/ des bdag la'o/ /brgyud rim 'di ni chos rje sa paṇa nas da lta'i bar gyi sdom gsum rab dbye'i bshad rgyun bar ma chad pa'i brgyud pa yin te/ 'di'i tshul/ mkhas mchog klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i sdom gsum rab dbye'i bshad rgyun gyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i lam rim dang smon lam bcas pa dngos grub kyi pho nya zhes bya ba las 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa yin pas/ sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin dpyod ldan gzur gnas rnams kyis snying la bcang bar gces so/

/'dir smras pa/ ā nan+da s+ya pu ṇ+ya dzñā sam+bho ga de/ kun dga'i bsod nams ye shes lhun grub sku/ /su ru tsi ra ha su bhā ṣa sastā ka ra/ rab mdzes ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /bha ba shān+ta shre ya gu ṇa rat+na ni dhe/ srid zhi'i dge legs yon tan rin chen gter/ /mañdzu gho ṣa gu d+ya pā da s+ya pad+me na maḥ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /gang sku ngur smrig rgyal mtshan gyis mdzes shing / /gang gsung gzhan skyon brjod pa'i dri mas dben/ /gang thugs zhe sdang khong khros ma gos pa'i/ /gang gi yon tan dran pas lhag par dad/ /bdag kyang dam pa khyed bzhin sku tshe bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pa dang / /mdzad pa'i 'phrin las ma lus mthar phyin te/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don rnams re ba bzhin/ /'grub ste skye dgu bde bas 'tsho gyur cig /chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thob pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba las/ rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyi zhal snga nas rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te lnga pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 a myes zhabs/ 'khon ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyis rjes su bzung ba'i tshul gyi sarga/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
